0x000185.en: 「Captain, I hate to bother you@　right when you've just woken up, but...」

0x000269.en: 「Right. If there's a No. 2,@　there must be a No. 1. Where's that one now?」

0x0002CE.en: 「Actually...@　it's back home minding the house for me.」

0x000351.en: 「All right, Mai!@　Let's do the preview anime-style!」

0x0003BE.en: 「No matter how many times the demons@　eyeing Earth send their minions!」

0x000407.en: 「As long as our steel spirit burns!」

0x000457.en: 「'Super Combining God Burn Blade 3,'@　Episode 12, 'Hammer of the Giant'!」

0x0004F3.en: 「...Wait, this is just@　the actual Burn Blade preview, isn't it.」

0x000566.en: 「...Stop it, please~@　Don't drag Mai into that world of yours~」

0x0005F2.en: 「What's wrong, Lamia? You don't look so good.」

0x00068F.en: 「Oh my~@　Did you open a new drawer again?」

0x0006D9.en: 「Yep. A girl's got@　plenty of different faces♪」

0x00071D.en: 「True enough... but saying that@　with a straight face is another matter.」

0x0007AC.en: 「I feel like...@　we've met somewhere before.」

0x0007F9.en: 「Not 'feel like'-we have met.@　The Inspector affair and the Shura Rebellion.」

0x000867.en: 「And besides that...@ launching your arms off, spewing steam,@ doing whatever you pleased.」

0x0008DC.en: 「My arms...?@　I have no such function.@　Who are you confusing me with, dark-bread girl?」

0x0009E8.en: 「Type C works for ranged combat,@　Type G excels in close combat.@　And Type N is somewhere in between...」

0x000A81.en: 「Best of all, you can swap between@　the three types in no time flat.」

0x000AE3.en: 「Oh yeah, you're banned from using Type G.」

0x000B4B.en: 「That one's mine.@　Besides, it's not your style.」

0x000BC9.en: 「Kidding, kidding.@　Just get the hang of all three types.」

0x000C5A.en: 「I'm the boss of Bannan Academy,@　head of the Kansai Todo Alliance-Michiru Hanaten.」

0x000CC2.en: 「Bet what's bugging you is@　how 'Hanaten' is written in kanji, right?」

0x000D3F.en: 「Listen up, 'Hanaten' is written 'Houshutsu.'@ Make sure you remember that.」

0x000DAB.en: 「Nah, what's bugging me is@　that a face like that goes by 'Michiru.'」

0x000E84.en: 「Yeah, like putting on a black mask.」

0x000EB5.en: 「A black mask...!?@　Ugh, that rings a bell... or maybe it doesn't...」

0x000F69.en: 「I met Second Lieutenant Lamia once before, you know...」

0x000FB2.en: 「Back then, seeing her@　in that full-on sexy outfit,@　I figured I could never pull it off myself, but...」

0x00104E.en: 「This DFC suit is@　full-on sexy dynamite too, isn't it...@　Especially once the jacket comes off.」

0x0010CF.en: 「Aah... everyone must think@　this is the kind of thing I'm into...」

0x001134.en: (Better not point out that it isn't.)

0x001171.en: 「Sure, I got seconded to the Elite Squad I admired, but...@ everyone's too amazing-there's nothing I'm the best at...」

0x00122E.en: 「When it comes to showing some skin, isn't@　that DFC suit of yours the best around?」

0x0012DA.en: (...Being a good sport might be her best trait too.)

0x001308.en: 「Hey, Touma.@　Besides Asakusa and Comodin Island,@　what kinds of part-time jobs did you work?」

0x00138A.en: 「I've worked over a hundred jobs, but@　the most dangerous of them all was...」

0x0013FB.en: 「Selling merch at the Burning PT nationals in Makuhari,@　guarding the Barrelor unveiling ceremony in Odaiba...」

0x001484.en: 「Both of those got caught up in fighting, but@　hawking grilled squid in Hakodate@　was where my life flashed before my eyes...」

0x00151A.en: 「Oh, now I remember. I was there that time too.」

0x001561.en: 「U-um, I'm Azuki Sawa.@　I used to be on the second bridge, but...@　I've just been reassigned to the first bridge.」

0x001612.en: 「Looking forward to working with you,@　Eita!」

0x001663.en: 「Yes, yes-@　I've finally got a cute junior of my own!」

0x0016BA.en: 「Hm?@　In the anime, wasn't Azuki on the first bridge@　even before the Inspector affair...?」

0x00173B.en: 「And didn't she have@　more screen time and lines than Eita...?」

0x00183A.en: 「Sure are a lot of cute girls.」

0x00185C.en: 「You said it~ From the sweet, devoted little-sister type@ to the sharp big-sister type you'd love to be stepped on by-@ take your pick!」

0x0018F5.en: 「And the one who really catches my eye is...」

0x001958.en: 「Whaat!? No, that one's way out of bounds...」

0x0019AC.en: 「Listen up, you lot. The MTDM Shooter...」

0x0019EC.en: 「That's the Micro Tesla Drive Missile.@　When you fire that thing, be extremely careful.」

0x001A83.en: 「I-is it really that dangerous a weapon?」

0x001ABA.en: 「Yeah. It makes a missile out of@　an actual Tesla Drive, after all.@　Every single shot is dead expensive.」

0x001B85.en: 「Hmm...@　several dozen times a regular missile, I'd say.」

0x001BEB.en: 「...Actually,@　how much does a regular missile cost, anyway?」

0x001C57.en: 「I've no intention of making a losing bet...」

0x001D15.en: 「Oh dear~@　You drew the Joker, clean as can be.@　There we go-Kyosuke loses, loses~!」

0x001DD4.en: 「...It's practically become a running gag by now,@　I suppose, but I'd better say it here all the same.」

0x001E64.en: 「Look forward to the Hero Operation too!」

0x001F03.en: 「Mmm~@　Sweets after training are the best!」

0x001F51.en: 「Nice work, Ibis. I made some tea.」

0x001FB9.en: 「I'll add some sugar for you too.」

0x002007.en: 「U-um, isn't that...@　a bit too much...?」

0x00204B.en: 「Oh, really? It's only my sixth cup.」

0x0020D2.en: 「How do these two not gain any weight!?@　It's not fair!」

0x0021A4.en: (Drink something that sweet and you'll get cavities...)
